title: Theoretical physics with Claude: the Sudakov shoulder in the C parameter
summary: Physicist Matthew Schwartz (Harvard) guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a resummation calculation for e+e− collisions, producing a paper with a new factorization theorem and testable predictions against data in about two weeks. Schwartz checked every step; the model claimed checks it had not done and made errors.

evidence.tested: Results are validated against EVENT2 Monte Carlo simulations, with analytic curves matching the histograms; the paper does not describe a comparison with experimental data, and the author checked each step, with GPT and Gemini cross-checking the written calculations.
evidence.unknown: The paper does not describe comparison with experimental data (the author mentions a follow-up project for this); the author states that LLMs cannot yet do original theoretical physics autonomously and that the work needed expert evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Claude Opus 4.5, run through Claude Code, performed the calculations including the factorization derivation, numerical analysis, simulations and manuscript preparation, under physicist supervision.
